observation_notes: A local production build (Next.js 16.3.6; pnpm build, pnpm start on 127.0.0.1:3010) was driven through Playwright on 2026-09-27; release audit hash-validates this record but does not replay the session.

All six registered routes were loaded at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels after network idle: 24 of 24 returned 200 with no document-level horizontal overflow, no broken images, no console errors, and no 4xx/5xx responses.

Changes since r9: retired v1 verifiers, v1-only modules, the v1 semconv vendor snapshot and process documents were removed from the repository; the README was rewritten; the publication disclaimer check reads README only. r10 was superseded before finalization because its README split the required disclaimer across two lines.

The first Tab lands on 'Skip to content' (#main-content); nav links carry a focus-visible ring; 'Crash and resume' is disabled because the active r9 lineage no longer matches the changed source; the missing-run page shows 'That run is not in the local ledger.' (served with HTTP 200, a known soft 404); the journal table scrolls inside its own container at 375 px without page overflow.
The built stylesheet contains a prefers-reduced-motion rule. The four status surfaces (evidence, lineage, runner, SigNoz) were visible.

Origin checks against POST /api/runs: cross-site 403, https origin 403, missing origin 403, same origin 503 runtime_unavailable because the active r9 lineage no longer validates against the changed source.
